pages.running_header: מַעֲרִיב לֵיל רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה

texts.text: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃
uncertainties: The verse is in small type. The vowels are hard to read, especially on the final word תְּהִלָּתֶךָ (is the final kaf pointed with qamats?) and the dagesh in יַגִּיד.

texts.text: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא אֵל עֶלְיוֹן גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים וְקוֹנֵה הַכֹּל וְזוֹכֵר חַסְדֵי אָבוֹת וּמֵבִיא גוֹאֵל לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה׃
uncertainties: Is it וְקוֹנֵה (full) or וְקֹנֵה (defective)? The holam-vav is not clearly visible.
No dagesh is clearly visible in גוֹאֵל or in בְנֵיהֶם.

texts.text: זָכְרֵנוּ לַחַיִּים. מֶלֶךְ חָפֵץ בַּחַיִּים. וְכָתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר הַחַיִּים. לְמַעַנְךָ אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים. מֶלֶךְ עוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִׁיעַ וּמָגֵן. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מָגֵן אַבְרָהָם׃
uncertainties: The pointing of לְמַעַנְךָ is unclear (is there a sheva under the nun?).

texts.text: אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים אַתָּה רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ.
uncertainties: This line is printed tightly spaced. It ends with a period, not a sof pasuq.

texts.text: מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר. מִי כָמוֹךָ בַּעַל גְּבוּרוֹת וּמִי דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ מֶלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעָה׃
uncertainties: Is there a dagesh in דּוֹמֶה and in לָּךְ? Both look present but are faint.

texts.text: מִי כָמוֹךָ אַב הָרַחֲמִים. זוֹכֵר יְצוּרָיו לַחַיִּים בְּרַחֲמִים.
וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת מֵתִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מְחַיֵּה הַמֵּתִים׃
אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָ קָדוֹשׁ וּקְדוֹשִׁים בְּכָל־יוֹם יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה׃
uncertainties: סֶּלָה looks like it has a dagesh in the samekh. I am not sure.

texts.text: וּבְכֵן תֵּן פַּחְדְּךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל כָּל־מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְאֵימָתְךָ עַל כָּל־מַה־שֶּׁבָּרָאתָ וְיִירָאוּךָ כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ כָּל־הַבְּרוּאִים וְיֵעָשׂוּ כֻלָּם אֲגֻדָּה אַחַת לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם כְּמוֹ שֶׁיָּדַעְנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁהַשָּׁלְטָן לְפָנֶיךָ עֹז בְּיָדְךָ וּגְבוּרָה בִּימִינֶךָ וְשִׁמְךָ נוֹרָא עַל כָּל־מַה־שֶּׁבָּרָאתָ׃
uncertainties: Is the dagesh in the dalet of פַּחְדְּךָ there? It is unclear.
There is no maqaf between כָּל and הַמַּעֲשִׂים, as printed.
Is it שֶׁהַשָּׁלְטָן with qamats under the lamed? The pointing is hard to read.

texts.text: וּבְכֵן תֵּן כָּבוֹד יְיָ לְעַמֶּךָ תְּהִלָּה לִירֵאֶיךָ וְתִקְוָה לְדוֹרְשֶׁיךָ וּפִתְחוֹן פֶּה לַמְיַחֲלִים לָךְ שִׂמְחָה לְאַרְצֶךָ
uncertainties: This paragraph is incomplete. It continues on the next page, and no continuation has been added.
No word טוֹבָה appears after וְתִקְוָה, as printed. וְתִקְוָה ends one line and לְדוֹרְשֶׁיךָ begins the next.
Is it לַמְיַחֲלִים with patah under the lamed? The vowels are hard to read.

pages.running_header: Evening Prayer for the New Year

texts.text: Lord, open my lips and my mouth will tell of Thy fame.

Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God and the God of our fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob, the great, mighty and awe- inspiring God, God the Most High, who performs acts of kindness and owns everything and remembers the good deeds of the fathers and will bring a redeemer for their children's children for His Name's sake in love.
uncertainties: "awe- inspiring" is printed with a space after the hyphen, mid-line. It has been kept as printed.

texts.text: Remember us for life, O King who delights in life, and inscribe us in the book of life for Thy sake, O living God. O King, helper and saviour and shield, blessed art Thou, O Lord, the shield of Abraham.
Thou art for ever mighty, O Lord the reviver of the dead, Thou art great to save.
uncertainties: There is no comma after "O Lord", as printed.

texts.text: Sustaining life with kindness, reviving the dead with great compassion, supporting the falling and healing the sick and releasing captives and keeping His faith with those who sleep in the dust. Who is like Thee, Master of might, and who resembles Thee, O King, who slays and revives and causes salvation to spring forth.
Who is like Thee, Father of compassion, who remembers His creatures for life in compassion.
And Thou art faithful to revive the dead. Blessed art Thou, O Lord who revives the dead.
uncertainties: There is no comma after "O Lord", as printed.

texts.text: Thou art holy and Thy Name is holy and holy ones praise Thee every day. Selah!
uncertainties: The print has a wider gap before "Selah!". It has been normalized to a single space.

texts.text: And therefore put the fear of Thee, O Lord our God, upon all Thy works and awe of Thee upon all that Thou hast created, so that all works may fear Thee and all the created bow down before Thee and all of them may be made into one group for the performance of Thy will with a complete heart, since we know, O Lord our God, that dominion lies before Thee, that strength is in Thy hand and might in Thy right hand and that Thy Name inspires with awe all that Thou has created.
uncertainties: The final phrase is printed "Thou has created" (not "hast"). It has been kept as printed.
